documents.work/receipts/notes.md:
# Expense tracker handover

## Importing the pilot batch
The intake sheet accepts one row per payment. The raw amount stays in local currency until the finance pass is finished. A duplicate receipt is flagged on the Review tab.

## Exceptions
把一张收据拆成两笔支出时，必须填写原单据编号。Missing receipts are held in a folder named Pending Proof. An item may move to the monthly summary after the reviewer checks the amount and date.
documents.work/receipts/record.md:
# Expense tracker template decisions

The standard tracker lists office breakfasts on the Meals tab and travel advances on the Prepaid tab. Put statements awaiting manager approval in the Pending Signoff folder. Raw amount may be updated during budget review, before the sheet is circulated.
documents.work/handover/record.md:
# Customer survey readout

## Before sharing
Round response rates to one decimal place. Hide free-text comments that name an individual before a director opens the preview. Keep internal review copies separate from the final summary.

| Case | Viewer cue |
| --- | --- |
| Fewer than eight survey responses | Report the group as Too Small. |
| Response labels revised | 在术语变更页记录旧标签与新标签。 |
| Department summary ready to send | Export the department summary as PDF. |
documents.work/handover/notes.md:
# Customer feedback coding workshop

The training slide uses a warning badge on departments with fewer than five facilitators. Export the workshop roster as CSV. The slide explains how old survey categories map to facilitator duties. The department naming exercise is fictional.
documents.work/monday/notes.md:
# 周一库存差额复查

## 清单
本流程针对周一早班。先核对上周末的出入库总数，再打开本周清单。差额记录应注明计数方式与记录时间，月末再统一处理长期差额。

- 发现清单里同一箱出现两次时，把第二条移动到重复页。
- 仓库的复核抽样固定在周一上午十点。
- 复核结束后，把不能确认的差额交给当班盘点负责人。
documents.work/monday/record.md:
# 周二供应商盘点安排

周二上午十点核对本周新到纸箱。重复的送货单由采购内勤回寄。电子清单里要保留订货单号和内勤人员的复核签字。退货入库由售后另查。
documents.work/release/record.md:
# Desktop preview packaging notes

The preview is built after the platform smoke checks. The creator attaches the installed version to the test record. Preview package names begin with desk-preview followed by the build number. Append the architecture when publishing two builds with the same number.

此轮预览用单独的离线签名机签名。Verify the checksum from the Releases pane before deleting the local copy. A failed signature check pauses the upload and leaves the temporary file available for review.
documents.work/release/notes.md:
# Desktop support bundle

The support bundle is named desk-support followed by the case number. No live signing happens in the desktop support application. Check the recorded file count in the ticket view when sending logs and include a copy of the affected configuration.
documents.work/supplier/notes.md:
# 替代供应商样件评审

先给新样件扫码，保留样件外包装到评审结束。如果验证发现材质与登记不同，在通报里写出实际材质。技术合格的样件用紫色贴纸标记。这个标记只在该批评审期间有效。

评审期间如有两个样件使用相同编号，由质检员重新贴号。临时增加的评审步骤写在附页的补充试验区。所有关于成本的讨论在采购记录里单独留存。
documents.work/supplier/record.md:
# 正式供应商样件存放

正式供货批次用白色贴纸标记货架。样件通过外观复查后，仓库管理员按到货日期排序。评审记录附上商业报价表，质检员按需要重做外观检测。
documents.work/nearline/record.md:
# Nearline research export checklist

Verify that filenames match the index and that rows are sorted before making the export. The validation manifest stays next to the compressed archive. Delete the temporary staging directory after the test restore finishes.

无法识别的数据行保存在 rejected-rows.csv。Each training snapshot gets a fresh export number. The research coordinator is responsible for flagging folders that should be retained for a second restore test.
documents.work/nearline/notes.md:
# Daily analytics export

The validation manifest is sent to the event reporting team. Move bad timestamp records to daily-errors.csv. Temporary working folders may be cleared once the dashboard adopts the output. Each dashboard includes the reporting week and account label.
documents.work/room/notes.md:
# 小型培训室到场演练

## 入场
本次是动线测试，签到从门外开始。课程开始前用一张白纸摆出拟用桌椅位置。辅助听音器要从前台左侧上锁的抽屉取出。重复演练之间把门口的可移动招牌归位。

## 散场
把试用的感应胸卡交给签到台右侧工作人员。备用座椅要在散场后推回北墙的折叠屏后面。记录讲者转换与听众离场是否发生冲突。
documents.work/room/record.md:
# 培训室日常借用

门口招牌挂在北墙。课程签到后请把访客胸卡投入正门边的灰色回收箱。讲者需要的遥控器收在前台右侧的抽屉。讲台的备用座椅通常在南侧储物间。
documents.work/bike/record.md:
# Bicycle maintenance intake

Use this record when collecting training bicycles after a class. Start with a visual inspection and ask the instructor whether any brake drag was reported. Jobs involving a bent rim get an orange triangle tag.

Convert a trainee's nickname to the class identifier in the shared record. 取下来的小垫片先放进带盖的小格盒里。A replacement saddle can be fitted after the mechanic records the seat tube diameter. Put clear photos in the job folder alongside the signed inspection checklist.
documents.work/bike/notes.md:
# Bicycle shelter inspections

Damaged shelter signs get a yellow rectangle tag. Remove broken cable clips and place them in an open supply bucket under the shelter bench. Collect the signed site checklist before the staff meeting. Note which bicycle racks needed cleaning.
documents.work/seedling/notes.md:
# 阳台育苗试种记录

本次小批试种记录种植日期和容器编号，不合并不同试验组。浇水后检查外托盘，叶片碰到盖子就换更高的盖。开始适应户外前，把育苗盘推到能见明亮散射光的位置。

遇到装错标签的育苗格，在电子记录里写原标签和新编号。玻璃盖上的水珠太多时，用木夹留一个通风缝。两批苗归档后再比较出芽日期与所在格子的条件。
documents.work/seedling/record.md:
# 阳台花盆清洗

用旧木夹固定防滑垫。碎花盆贴上坏盆标签再移到储藏间。清洗区域放在阳台上能遮雨的地方。盘点时只核对已经清空的容器和使用状态。
documents.work/library/record.md:
# Branch interlibrary dispatch

Sort requests using the shipping list. Paper slips inside the envelope can stay in order by member ID. Outbound loan notices go to the originating library's lending desk. Staging bins are separate from items reserved for walk-in pickup.

无法在当日配齐的一组图书暂放在标为部分待配的篮子里。On each outgoing bundle, place the routing slip underneath the blue rubber band. Preserve reservations that will wait for the next dispatch.
documents.work/library/notes.md:
# Library exhibit transport

An event loan notice goes to the exhibits coordinator. Bundled reading lists use a white paper tie. Items reserved for local walk-in pickup are marked at the desk and held behind the information counter until their time slot.
documents.work/quota/notes.md:
# 小组数据作业配额交接

作业请求按小组统计，事件记录按本地日期查询。可以在观测面板看到拒绝，但应保留导致拒绝的窗口编号。配额申请表的资源类型必须填 CPU 小时，而非运行次数。

月初的计数核对以日志中第一条完成记录为准。暂时调高配额时，把调高原因写在值班记录的说明栏里。恢复原来的限额后，确认隔天的报表使用新的观察时段。
documents.work/quota/record.md:
# 样例执行报表

培训报表里的执行次数是演示数据，其中每周第一条开始记录会用黄色标识。报表格子默认用 UTC 日期。给学员解释配额时，先把报表发给培训负责人。
documents.work/backstage/record.md:
# Hall lighting rehearsal

Test the full cue list with a quiet audience. Record whether operators could see their printed controls. The balcony spots switch off during the second scene change. Check the map when resetting equipment after the test.

中场测试用的临时电池放在写着备用的抽屉里。After the last cue, the booth operator returns the laminated cue sheet to the stage manager. Leave the backup copy near the entrance to the booth.
documents.work/backstage/notes.md:
# Public hall opening checklist

Balcony lighting stays at reduced output until both doors open. Temporary window lighting uses battery packs in the unlocked storage basket. The house manager files attendance sheets. The stage manager places floor signs before visitors arrive.
documents.work/translation/notes.md:
# 工作手册翻译试行

每位译者校对自己的文档标题，检查阅读顺序是否符合手册。章节标题使用标题样式，不手动加粗段落。新的术语译法由本次手册的编辑负责人决定。

第一次给审阅人发稿时，文件名只在结尾加 -draft。未定稿的插图标题在审阅清单中保留方括号标记。所有评论处理完之后，在交接页记最终审阅人员和修改日期。
documents.work/translation/record.md:
# 宣传单页译稿制作

插图标题用圆括号标记。第一页的标题由设计经理统一指定。工作版文件名加 -preview，交给审阅人的纸质版本保持双面。排版审批结束后，设计师将 PDF 发给本地印刷人员。
documents.work/labels/record.md:
# Device label verification

The trial labels go on two test devices and their storage cases. Record the device ID before removing the old label. Print replacement tags in 14-point type if the original characters cannot be read. A signature confirms a second person compared the record and device.

未能判明归属的箱子用一条银色纸胶带标记。Walk-in equipment stays in the open rack until the inventory lead verifies the label. Only a verified asset moves to the permanent shelf.
documents.work/labels/notes.md:
# Workshop packaging guide

Print accessory label sheets in 11-point type. Sealed parcels waiting for collection sit on the open rack. Mark outgoing carry cases with transparent tape. Check the case contents once by weight and once by counting the individual packets.
documents.work/clinicforms/notes.md:
# 社区活动报名表复盘

目前复盘只统计本轮报名，去除重复提交后再合计。签名区不要纳入复盘拍照范围，照片仅用于表单优化。空白签名不补填，在核对表里记作待本人确认。

借用的表格夹要归还给活动前台的早班同事。新版报名表的右上角应印上蓝色版本号。现场口头修订可写在工作人员的笔记里，下轮统一更新表格模板。
documents.work/clinicforms/record.md:

入口展示页的左下角印红色版本号。未发完的模板放在前台晚班同事的抽屉。签到表不能展示在公开区域，活动信息卡可摆在公告栏旁。
documents.work/adapter/record.md:
# AV cart commissioning checklist

Connect the cart to the test display after moving it out of storage. Leave the display in its input test mode until the picture and sound have been verified. Spare HDMI adapters live in the shallow tray below the power strip.

换掉磨损的插头后，在车架前面的接线图上贴一个星号。The AV coordinator checks that the cart rolls without pinching the cables. Its test notes list the monitor model and where the test was performed.
documents.work/adapter/notes.md:
# AV storage reset

Spare audio adapters are in a deep crate behind the tool panel. Mark returned cables using a removable dot. The inventory assistant checks wrapping and counts power strips before restocking. Leave defective carts separated until a replacement is ready.
documents.work/market/notes.md:
# 小区义卖摊位收尾

开始收尾前，请对照摊位号核对价签。旧价签保留到货款复核完毕，所有无法正常收纳的物品移出行走通道。预售后剩的宣传书签放到东门服务桌。

摊位交接表由负责最后一轮巡场的人签名。搬走摊架时，把待返还的挂牌挂在推车左侧把手上。稍后由值班员把待取物品送到另一个指定地点。
documents.work/market/record.md:
# 义卖预备会物资摆放

各摊位的全新价签放在西门签到桌。纸质书签由宣传小组统一发放。物资箱带回时，挂在推车右侧的醒目标识由库房人员查看。准备会记录由主持人签字。
documents.work/renderqueue/record.md:
# Print proof signoff

The proofing coordinator checks color and text size against the order record. Keep the approved proof with the work order until the production batch is counted. The second test page uses uncoated stock.

第一次打样的、更改前的 PDF 放在版本对照目录里。Work orders waiting for a color adjustment carry an amber flag. Add a note with the requested change before sending the updated proof back to the requester.
documents.work/renderqueue/notes.md:
# Training guide to print imposition

An exercise with folded stock uses a coated second page. Store the initial calendar demo in the examples folder. Urgent work orders carry a red flag. Requests are sorted by classroom, then by scheduled delivery week.
